title: Roof Replacement in Sandy, OR
summary: In June 2025, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Sandy, OR. The crew tore the old shingles off down to the decking, put down new plywood decking where the old deck came off, laid new underlayment and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the decking
Put down new plywood decking over the rafters where the old deck came off
Installed Safeguard 30 underlayment over the deck
New drip edge, gutter apron and starter strip along the roof edges
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with hip and ridge cap
New step flashing at the walls, attic vents and pipe flashings
Cleaned up the job site and ran a magnet sweep for nails

faqs.question: Did the old decking get replaced on this Sandy job?
faqs.answer: Yes, where it needed it. Once the old roof came off, the crew put down new plywood decking over the rafters before the underlayment and shingles went on.
